The gateway 500s (#85, #104, #117, #122) are that error reaching the edge. The 500s are partial, which fits a code path that only some orders hit. verdict.recommendedAction: Roll order-service back to v5.17.3. Then fix order-formatter.ts:181 so it handles orders with no locale, for example with a default locale, and add a test for that case before redeploying.
